sequences.title: VK-only Write: In the libiec61850 library, `parseAarePdu` in `libiec61850/src/mms/iso_acse/acse.c` has an out-of-bounds read found by fuzzing. When parsing the `0xbe` (`user information`) tag, `bufPos` is advanced by `BerDecoder_decodeLength(...)` and then `buffer[bufPos]` is read without a bounds check. The report states that malformed input ending with bytes such as `be 00` can leave `bufPos` past the end of the buffer and trigger the out-of-bounds read in the `case 0xbe` path.

sequences.title: VK-only GetVariableAccessAttributes: A fuzzing-discovered out-of-bounds write was reported in libiec61850 in `BerEncoder_encodeBitString` in `src/mms/asn1/ber_encoder.c`. The issue is triggered while encoding `MMS_BIT_STRING` `MmsData`: the function writes the tag, encoded length, padding byte, and bit-string bytes into `buffer` by advancing `bufPos`, but the report says it does not properly validate that `bufPos` stays within the valid buffer range. The report states this can occur if `bitStringSize` is large enough or if `bufPos` is already near the end of the buffer, resulting in writes past the end of `buffer`.
